svg.title: The four-cell plan by actor
svg.desc: A chart of the 19-step plan for the four-cell problem. Three rows, tagged 1 for inspection robot 1, 2 for inspection robot 2 and 3 for agv1. The x axis is the plan step, 1 to 19, an order and not a time. Each step is one box in the row of the robot or AGV that acts. inspection robot 1 picks and places c1 (tester 1) and c2 (tester 2) in steps 1 to 4, picks c3 in step 5, places it on tester 1 in step 8, picks c4 in step 9 and places it on tester 1 in step 12. inspection robot 2 picks c1 from tester 1 and places it in slot s1 in steps 6 and 7, does the same for c3 (s3) in steps 10 and 11 and c4 (s4) in steps 13 and 14, then picks c2 from tester 2 and places it in s2 in steps 15 and 16. agv1 checks the kit in step 17, moves to shipping in step 18 and submits in step 19. Only one box appears in each column.

path.aria-label: plan step (an order, not a time)
